text_en: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years; and the Lord said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and very much of the land still remains to be possessed.
text_cn: 若苏厄年纪已老，上主对他说：“你年纪已老，但还有广大的地区应当占领。

text_en: This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all those of the Geshurites
text_cn: 还应占领的地区：是培肋舍特人的整个地区，和革叔尔人的全境；

text_en: (from the Shihor, which is east of Egypt, northward to the boundary of Ekron, it is reckoned as Canaanite; there are five rulers of the Philistines, those of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron), and those of the Avvim
text_cn: 由埃及东方的史曷尔，到北方的厄刻龙的边界，这是属客纳罕人的地区；那五个培肋舍特酋长所管辖的迦萨人、阿市多得人、阿市刻隆人、加特人和厄刻龙人的地区，以及南方的阿威人地区；

text_en: in the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the boundary of the Amorites,
text_cn: 还有客纳罕人的全境，即由漆冬人的阿辣，直到阿费克，而后直到阿摩黎人的边界地区；

text_en: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath,
text_cn: 还有革巴耳人的地区，及东方的整个黎巴嫩区，由赫尔孟山麓的巴耳加得，直到哈玛特关口。

text_en: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, even all the Sidonians. I will myself drive them out from before the Israelites; only allot the land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
text_cn: 从黎巴嫩直到西方的米斯勒佛特玛殷，所有住在山地的居民，所有的漆冬人，我必从以色列子民面前，把他们赶走。你只管照我指示你的，将这地抽签分给以色列人作为产业。

text_en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh. ”
text_cn: 现在你要将这地方分给九支派和默纳协半支派作为产业。”

text_en: With the other half-tribe of Manasseh the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them:
text_cn: 默纳协另半支派和勒乌本并加得二支派，已经得了梅瑟在约但河东岸分给他们的产业；按上主的仆人梅瑟分给他们的产业，

text_en: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, and the town that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland from Medeba as far as Dibon;
text_cn: 是从阿尔农谷旁的阿洛厄尔起，包括谷中的城邑，全默德巴高原，直到狄朋；

text_en: and all the cities of King Sihon of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the boundary of the Ammonites;
text_cn: 还有在赫市朋为王的阿摩黎人王息红所有的城市，直到阿孟子民的边疆；

text_en: and Gilead, and the region of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
text_cn: 还有基肋阿得和革叔尔人与玛阿加人的领土，以及全赫尔孟山，全巴商，一直到撒耳加；

text_en: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he alone was left of the survivors of the Rephaim); these Moses had defeated and driven out.
text_cn: 又巴商王敖格的全国领土，他原是勒法因人最后的遗族，在阿市塔洛特和厄德勒为王。这些地方的人，都被梅瑟击败赶走了。

text_en: Yet the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites; but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
text_cn: 以色列子民却没有赶走革叔尔人和玛阿加人，因此革叔尔人和玛阿加人直到现在仍住在以色列人中间。

text_en: To the tribe of Levi alone Moses gave no inheritance; the offerings by fire to the Lord God of Israel are their inheritance, as he said to them.
text_cn: 惟独肋未支派没有分得产业，因为上主以色列的天主自己是他们的产业，有如上主对他们所说的。

text_en: Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the Reubenites according to their clans.
text_cn: 梅瑟给勒乌本支派，按照他们的家族，分了一份产业。

text_en: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, and the town that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland by Medeba;
text_cn: 他们的地区，是从阿尔农谷旁的阿洛厄尔，包括谷中的城邑，直到默德巴整个高原。

text_en: with Heshbon, and all its towns that are in the tableland; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
text_cn: 赫市朋和在这高原所有的城市：狄朋、巴摩特巴耳、贝特巴耳默红、

text_en: and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
text_cn: 雅哈兹、刻德摩特、默法阿特、

text_en: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,
text_cn: 克黎雅塔因、息贝玛、山中盆地的责勒特沙哈尔、

text_en: and Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
text_cn: 贝特培敖尔、丕斯加山坡、贝特耶史摩特、

text_en: that is, all the towns of the tableland, and all the kingdom of King Sihon of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses defeated with the leaders of Midian, Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, as princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
text_cn: 高原上各城市，和在赫市朋为王的阿摩黎人王息红的整个国土。梅瑟曾杀了息红和住在那地方上的息红藩属，米德杨的酋长：厄威、勒耿、族尔、胡尔和勒巴。

text_en: Along with the rest of those they put to death, the Israelites also put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.
text_cn: 以色列子民杀这些人时，也用刀杀了贝敖尔的儿子巴郎术士。

text_en: And the border of the Reubenites was the Jordan and its banks. This was the inheritance of the Reubenites according to their families with their towns and villages.
text_cn: 勒乌本子孙的地区以约但河为界：以上是勒乌本子孙按照家族，分得作为产业的城市和所属的村镇。

text_en: Moses gave an inheritance also to the tribe of the Gadites, according to their families.
text_cn: 梅瑟按照他们的家族，给加得支派，给加得子孙，分了一份产业。

text_en: Their territory was Jazer, and all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites, to Aroer, which is east of Rabbah,
text_cn: 他们的地区是雅则尔，基肋阿得所有的城邑和阿孟人的一半土地，直到辣巴对面的阿洛厄尔；

text_en: and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir,
text_cn: 又从赫市朋直到辣玛特米兹帕和贝托宁，从玛哈纳殷到罗德巴尔的边境；

text_en: and in the valley Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon, the Jordan and its banks, as far as the lower end of the Sea of Chinnereth, eastward beyond the Jordan.
text_cn: 还有谷中盆地的贝特哈兰、贝特尼默辣、稣苛特、匝丰、赫市朋王息红国中的其余土地；以约但河为界，沿约但河东岸直到基乃勒特海的顶端：

text_en: This is the inheritance of the Gadites according to their clans, with their towns and villages.
text_cn: 以上是加得子孙按照家族，分得作为产业的城市和所属的村镇。

text_en: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh; it was allotted to the half-tribe of the Manassites according to their families.
text_cn: 梅瑟也给默纳协半支派，给默纳协半支派子孙，按照他们的家族，分了一份产业。

text_en: Their territory extended from Mahanaim, through all Bashan, the whole kingdom of King Og of Bashan, and all the settlements of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty towns,
text_cn: 他们的地区是起自玛哈纳殷，包括全部巴商，即巴商王敖格的全部国土，巴商境内属雅依尔的各村庄，共六十村庄；

text_en: and half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan; these were allotted to the people of Machir son of Manasseh according to their clans—for half the Machirites.
text_cn: 还有基肋阿得的一半和敖格在巴商的都城阿市塔洛特和厄德勒：以上地区按照家族，分给了默纳协的儿子玛基尔的子孙，即玛基尔的一半子孙。

text_en: These are the inheritances that Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan east of Jericho.
text_cn: 以上是梅瑟在约但河东岸，耶里哥面对摩阿布旷野里，所划分的产业。

text_en: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the Lord God of Israel is their inheritance, as he said to them.
text_cn: 至于肋未支派，梅瑟没有给他们分配产业，因为上主以色列的天主自己是他们的产业，有如上主对他们所说的。
